blocks.text: Esther 9 contains 32 verses. It opens with: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have rule over them, (whereas it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them,) It concludes with: And the commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
